name: voice_quality
description: Tests the voice RAG endpoint (/api/rag-search): retrieval relevance, grounding, first-person framing, source attribution. NOTE: spoken-output properties (brevity, no markdown, no spoken URLs) are deliberately NOT tested here — this endpoint returns retrieval CONTEXT and falls back to raw markdown chunks when RAG exceeds its latency budget, so those assertions were testing the wrong layer. Spoken output is covered by the voice integration harness in process/scratch/phase-5b/.

tests.description: Voice RAG about the pentesting system returns relevant content
tests.input: Tell me about your penetration testing system

tests.description: Voice RAG surfaces the fleet-scale reliability work
tests.input: What reliability work have you done?

tests.description: Voice RAG surfaces the operator dashboard work
tests.input: Have you built any internal tools or dashboards?

tests.description: Voice RAG never presents a nonexistent project as real (tier-independent — refusal wording only appears on the reasoned tier)
tests.input: Tell me about your blockchain project

assertions.criteria: The content must NOT present factual details about a blockchain project belonging to the speaker as though such a project exists. It is acceptable for the content to explicitly deny having one, OR to be unrelated retrieved material that simply never mentions a blockchain project of theirs. It is NOT acceptable if it describes a blockchain project they built.

tests.description: Voice RAG answers in first person as Taher, never third person
tests.input: Who are you and what do you do?

tests.description: Voice RAG attributes retrieved content to a source so the badge UI has something to render
tests.input: What is your experience with machine learning?
